title: A Noble Arrival
text:
*You step out of line, chin raised, and walk directly toward the sergeant at the gate. The crowd parts — something in your bearing commands it.*

Guard Sergeant: "Hold. Papers."

*You produce the sealed letter, stamped with the Duke's crest. The sergeant's eyes widen a fraction — the only sign of surprise he permits himself.*

Guard Sergeant: "An envoy. We were told to expect someone, though not so... presentable. Welcome to Ashenmoor. Mind the Lowmarket after dark — we've had trouble."

*He waves you through with something approaching respect. Beyond the gate, the city unfolds before you — cramped streets, leaning buildings, and above it all, the Duke's estate on the hill, shrouded in grey mist.*

choices.text: Ask the sergeant about the 'trouble' he mentioned
Thank him and proceed into the city
